glenn: 27 Oct 8:08 pm: Instagram screenshots (@fresca_sf, 'Nuevo Peruvian cuisine serving SF since 1996', 'Now open for lunch', sister restaurant @puerto27restaurant), https://linktr.ee/frescasf, 'San Francisco • Eats / BEASTY • Eats'
flags: Instagram contact button says (415) 742-5727 and ivan@frescasf.com; their site, Google and Yelp give 415-718-5232 and the site gives contact@frescasf.com, which are used.
Founding year disagrees: Instagram/Linktree say 'since 1996'; their site's Our Story says 'Since opening in 1987'. Neither is in the tagline.
Happy hour: their site says Mon–Fri 3–5:30pm (used); OpenTable says 3–6pm in one listing and 3–6:30pm in another.

Menu is their site's /menu. Their Toast ordering page prices differ (e.g. Lomo Saltado $37 vs $34, Ceviche Nikkei $27 vs $26, Causa $32 vs $29, La Jalea $22 vs $25), many Toast descriptions sit on the wrong dishes, and Toast alone has a lunch menu, desserts and a kids menu; none of that is shown. orderUrl points at Toast, so ordered prices may not match these.
Salad add-ons ('+chicken $24 …') and saltado variants ('-surf n turf $44 …') are printed ambiguously (total or add-on), so they are kept as printed in the descriptions, not as items.
Pisco and house cocktails, martinis, wine and beer left out (age check); zero-proof and soft drinks kept.
Gold #DFB756 (badge lettering) not stored: no second-colour key. color is the badge purple #7B418B, sampled from the logo.
Logo from their Facebook page picture at 1080px; Instagram only serves the same badge at 100px without sign-in, and the site's og:image is the white wordmark on transparent.

Stale elsewhere: the 737 Irving St Fresca closed 30 Sep 2023 (Toast still lists it); a Frankiapp listing gives (415) 695-0549 and older OpenTable hours (10am weekend openings). Reopened at 24th St on 24 Aug 2026 per their Facebook post.
Sister restaurant @puerto27restaurant (from Glenn's screenshot) not researched.
